nodes.label: Gateway-only frontend boundary
nodes.rationale: The frontend only talks to the gateway so the browser never needs to know internal services; the gateway fans out to catalog-service and orders-service.

nodes.label: OrderDto central contract
nodes.rationale: OrderDto is deliberately the central contract in the demo; adding a field to it forces coordinated changes in orders-service, api-gateway, and web-frontend, but not catalog-service.

nodes.label: Contract lockstep requirement
nodes.rationale: The C# and TypeScript contract definitions must stay synchronized so every repository uses matching wire shapes and routes.

nodes.label: OrderDto passthrough verification
nodes.rationale: The gateway forwards OrderDto without reshaping it, so OrderDto changes usually require review and verification rather than code transformation.
